cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Providing African small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and operators with a 100% offline, privacy-guaranteed AI workspace for parsing confidential financial documents (XLSX, PDF, DOCX), drafting business reports, and automating workflow tasks without cloud subscription fees or data leak risks on budget 8 GB RAM laptops.

test_prompts.prompt: Analyze the attached quarterly income statement and summarize key revenue trends, cost drivers, and profit margins for executive decision-makers.
Draft a formal non-disclosure agreement (NDA) template suitable for a small tech business onboarding a new local vendor, highlighting key confidentiality clauses.
